title: Methodological literature on epigenetic clocks as causal vs. proxy biomarkers
book_use: Chapter 11; The Rapamycin Underground; Checked 2026-09-02; Supports: Mendelian-randomization evidence questioning whether clock CpG sites are causal aging drivers; distinction between predictive biomarkers and intervention targets; Limits: The causal interpretation of epigenetic clocks remains an active research area; this source should not be used to claim clocks have no biological value.
